symptom: `alter entity … add attribute` on an entity with a Studio Pro index over (createdDate, changedDate) rewrote each segment as `Type = Normal` with still no attribute pointer; mx check then crashed with ArgumentOutOfRangeException at IndexedAttribute.get_Attribute instead of reporting a CE (mendixlabs/mxcli#1451, reported on v0.24.0 / 0.26.0, Mendix 11.12.5).
cause: Same defect as #1401, already fixed on main when #1451 was filed: indexFromGen dropped IndexedAttribute.Type and indexToGen hard-coded "Normal". #1401's tests pinned the converter pair and describe, not the reported ALTER sequence through the real write path.
file: mdl/backend/modelsdk/issue1451_alter_system_index_test.go (regression only; fix in domainmodel.go indexFromGen / domainmodel_write.go indexToGen from #1401)
insight: Check whether the report predates a fix before writing one: the issue quoted main's code, but a grep of the cited line (`seg.SetType("Normal")`) on the current tree showed it already gone, and the real repro on a blank 11.12.5 app passed. What earned its place was the end-to-end test: seed the Studio Pro shape by patching the unit below the writer (Type CreatedDate/ChangedDate, zero AttributePointer), alter through UpdateEntity, read the raw segments; reverting either half of #1401 makes it fail with exactly the reported `Type = "Normal"`. Real run, both variants: fixed binary 0 errors; binary with indexToGen forced to Normal reproduces the get_Attribute crash. Do not chase the owner/changedBy half of the title: the Model SDK (mendixmodelsdk 4.116.0) does add IndexedAttributeType Owner/ChangedBy/Association and an `association` reference (AssociationPointer) in 11.11.0, absent from our gen, and a rewrite does zero a stored AssociationPointer — but mx 11.12.5 AND 11.14.0 crash in Index.Check -> get_Attribute on ANY segment of those types (zero pointer, a dangling one, or one naming a real association in the unit), so no project holding one passes mx check today; carrying the pointer protects a shape with no checkable instance. Revisit when a Studio Pro-authored owner/association index exists to measure. The domain-model unit stores entities as DomainModels$EntityImpl, so a raw patch matching `DomainModels$Entity` silently finds nothing.
